static get_default_checked_profile_names() → set[str][source]

Get the CGMES profiles that shall remain checked by default.

The dialogue previously defaulted to the classic/core export set plus CO. The newer NCP profiles are now visible, but they stay unchecked by default because the exporter does not yet synthesize those datasets from a plain VeraGrid model.

Returns:

Set of profile names checked by default.
